name: Coconut
soilType: Coastal sandy loam, alluvial, red sandy loam with good drainage
growthTips: Apply 50 kg farmyard manure + 1.3 kg Urea + 2 kg Superphosphate + 2 kg Muriate of Potash per palm annually.
Grow green manure crops (Sunnhemp / Cowpea) in palm basins during monsoon.

commonDiseases.name: Bud Rot & Stem Bleeding
symptoms: Yellowing and rotting of central spindle leaf
Spindle easily pulls out emitting foul odor
Exudation of dark reddish liquid through bark cracks
causes: Heavy monsoon rains with high relative humidity
organicTreatment: Clean crown and place 10g copper sulfate + 10g lime pouch on crown
Apply Bordeaux paste on stem cracks
chemicalTreatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L crown drenching
prevention: Prophylactic crown cleaning and 1% Bordeaux mixture spray before monsoon

name: Turmeric
soilType: Well-drained fertile sandy loam or clay loam rich in humus
growthTips: Heavy mulching with green leaves (5 tonnes/acre) at planting and at 45 & 90 days boosts yield.
Rhizome seed treatment with Trichoderma viride prevents basal rot.

commonDiseases.name: Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot
symptoms: Water-soaked lesions at collar region of pseudostem
Rhizomes become soft, pulpy, with foul smell
causes: Waterlogging in heavy soils during continuous rains
prevention: Plant on raised beds (ridge and furrow)

name: Soybean
soilType: Fertile, well-drained deep black or medium loam (pH 6.5 - 7.5)
growthTips: Inoculate seed with Bradyrhizobium japonicum before sowing.
Avoid sowing deeper than 3-4 cm to ensure uniform germination.

commonDiseases.name: Soybean Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV)
Mungbean yellow mosaic India virus
High
name: Bright yellow irregular patches on young leaves
Leaves turn completely golden yellow and puckered
Pods are small with few, shriveled seeds
Whitefly vector transmission in hot, humid weather
Install 20 yellow sticky traps/acre
Spray 5% NSKE or 10,000 ppm Neem oil @ 2 mL/L
Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.4 g/L water
Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.4 g/L water
Use YMV-resistant cultivars (JS-9560, JS-2034)
Treat seeds with Imidacloprid 48% FS @ 1.25 mL/kg seed
